summary: Movie booking app inspired by BookMyShow with animated text, cover art, food items page, fake bill receipt, and seat selection. User has requested admin access/role.

existing_features.title: Add an admin self-promotion UI flow: when a logged-in Internet Identity user visits the Admin page and is not yet an admin, display a 'Claim Admin Access' button that calls the backend to grant them admin privileges (only succeeds if no admin exists yet or they are already an admin). After a successful claim, refresh the admin status and grant access to the AdminPanel.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add admin role/access for the user

Add a backend function that allows a bootstrapped super-admin principal (hardcoded or set on first call when no admin exists) to grant the admin role to a given principal. On canister initialization, automatically assign the admin role to the deployer's principal so the first user can self-promote.
